laura: quick micro-standup — did: updated python SDK quickstart (added async example), fixed a couple README typos in samples. blocker: macOS CI flaky failing test intermittently (can't repro locally). today: triage CI + cut small doc patch, prep PR for sampleapp threading. ping @miguel for CI node access.
sam: on it — can pick up CI triage after lunch. which test id? share failing log?
miguel: saw this yesterday — suspect `test_pool_concurrency` in samples/test_integration.py. might be `uvloop` on ARM. I have access to the runners, will take a look.
priya: docs-lint added a new rule that flagged a couple examples; happy to help polish quickstart wording and push fixes.
laura: thanks. PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/234 (small). failing snippet: `AssertionError: expected 200 != 503` — looks like transient timeout.
sam: quick try: bump request timeout in that test to `timeout=10` and rerun. if stable we can increase sample default or add retry. @priya can you update the code example to show `timeout=10`?
priya: will do a tiny change and push, assign to @laura for review.
docs-bot: Deploy preview created — https://deploy-preview-238.docs.redwood.ai (includes python quickstart changes). preview expires in 7 days.
miguel: ETA on CI check ~2h, can run failing test locally on an M1 instance if needed.
laura: perfect, no other blockers from me. thanks team :thumbsup:
